title: Accessing data from the IGVF Catalog
text: Impact Genomic Variation Function (IGVF) Consortium, aims understand genomic variation affects genome function, turn impacts phenotype. NHGRI funding collaborative program brings together teams investigators use state---art experimental computational approaches model, predict, characterize map genome function, genome function shapes phenotype, processes affected genomic variation. joint efforts produce catalog impact genomic variants genome function phenotypes. IGVF Catalog described last sentence available number interfaces, including web interface well two programmatic interfaces. addition, Data Portal, raw processed data can downloaded, web interface client library R. package, rigvf, focuses Catalog Data Portal.

title: Accessing data from the IGVF Catalog
text: IGVF Catalog form knowledge graph, nodes biological entities variants, genes, pathways, etc. edges relationships nodes, e.g. empirically measured effects variants cis-regulatory elements (CREs) transcripts proteins. edges may metadata including information cell type context information association measured, e.g. experiment predictive model.

title: Accessing data from the IGVF Catalog

title: Accessing data from the IGVF Catalog
text: IGVF Catalog offers two programmatic interfaces, Catalog API ArangoDb interface, described . Catalog API preferred, optimized queries relevant information. Queries simple REST requests implemented using httr2 package. query variants associated “GCK”; one also use, e.g., Ensembl identifiers. Note receive limited number responses. can change page responses receive limit per page: can also pass thresholds negative log10 p-value effect size, using following letter combinations, gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), followed : value. See examples : help page ?catalog_queries outlines available user-facing functions. Note nested columns response can widen-ed using tidyr. example, querying genomic elements associated gene, get back nested output:

text: show simple example plotting variants elements gene context, using plotgardener package. First selecting variants around gene GCK (reminder obtain first limit number variants, see ?catalog_queries details). load plotgardener define default parameters. Renaming columns: match correct gene annotation, explicitly define transcript database using plotgardener::assembly(), provide database built running GenomicFeatures::makeTxDbFromGFF() GENCODE GTF file. use one standard hg38 TxDb UCSC-style chromosome names. build page populate annotation TxDb used plotgardener IGVF Catalog.

what: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
title: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
text: Objects documented page developer use. arango_request() formulates 'GET' 'POST' ArangoDB API. arango_auth() uses username password authenticate database. arango_collections() implements _api/collection endpoint available collections IGVF database. arango_cursor() implements _api/cursor endpoint allow user-specified query IGVF database.

title: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
code: arango_request(path, ..., body = NULL, jwt_token = NULL)  arango_auth(   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )  arango_collections(   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )  arango_cursor(   query,   ...,   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )

title: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
text: path character(1) path API end point. Note database-specfic paths prefixed /_db/igvf. ... arango_request(), named arguments used query parameters. arango_cursor(), named arguments interpreted bind variables query. body NULL, formulate POST request JSON body. jwt_token character(1) JWT token obtained via arango_auth(). username character(1) ArangoDB user name. Default: "guest". password character(1) ArangoDB password. Default: "guestigvfcatalog". better practice use environment variable record password, rather encoding script, password = Sys.getenv("RIGVF_ARANGODB_PASSWORD"). query character(1) FILE NAME (without extension .aql query template.

title: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
text: arango_request() returns JSON response character(1) vector. arango_auth() returns JWT token used authentication subsequent calls. arango_collections() returns tibble columns name, type (either 'node' 'edge'), count. arango_cursor() returns JSON character(1) 'result' query.

title: Internal interface to ArangoDB REST API — arango
text: arango_auth() 'memoized', invoked per hour particular user password. memoised result can cleared memoise::forget(arango_auth). arango_cursor() expects queries written package system files inst/aql directory. allows rapid iteration query development (package need re-loaded query updated) opportunity language-specific highlighting supported developer's text editor.

what: Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API — catalog_queries
title: Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API — catalog_queries
text: page documents functions using IGVF REST API, documented https://api.catalogkg.igvf.org/#. Note functions return limited number responses, see limit page arguments control number responses. gene_variants() locates variants associated gene. one gene_id, hgnc, gene_name, alias specified. variant_genes() locates genes associated variant. one spdi, hgvs, rsid, variant_id, chr + position specified. gene_elements() locates elements associated gene. elements() locates genomic elements based genomic range query. element_genes() locates genomic elements associated genes based genomic range query.

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API — catalog_queries
code: gene_variants(   gene_id = NULL,   hgnc = NULL,   gene_name = NULL,   alias = NULL,   organism = "Homo sapiens",   log10pvalue = NULL,   effect_size = NULL,   page = 0L,   limit = 25L,   verbose = FALSE )  variant_genes(   spdi = NULL,   hgvs = NULL,   rsid = NULL,   variant_id = NULL,   chr = NULL,   position = NULL,   organism = "Homo sapiens",   log10pvalue = NULL,   effect_size = NULL,   page = 0L,   limit = 25L,   verbose = FALSE )  gene_elements(gene_id = NULL, page = 0L, limit = 25L, verbose = FALSE)  elements(range = NULL, page = 0L, limit = 25L)  element_genes(range = NULL, page = 0L, limit = 25L, verbose = FALSE)

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API — catalog_queries
text: gene_id character(1) Ensembl gene identifier, e.g., "ENSG00000106633" hgnc character(1) HGNC identifier gene_name character(1) Gene symbol, e.g., "GCK" alias character(1) Gene alias organism character(1) Either 'Homo sapiens' (default) 'Mus musculus' log10pvalue character(1) following can used set thresholds negative log10pvalue: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), ":" following value, e.g., "gt:5.0" effect_size character(1) Optional string used thresholding effect size variant gene. See 'log10pvalue'. E.g., "gt:0.5" page integer(1) response items limit, offers pagination. starts page 0L, next 1L, ... limit integer(1) limit parameter controls page size can exceed 1000 verbose logical(1) return additional information variants genes spdi character(1) SPDI variant hgvs character(1) HGVS variant rsid character(1) RSID variant variant_id character(1) IGVF variant ID chr character(1) UCSC-style chromosome name variant, e.g. "chr1" position character(1) 0-based position variant range query GRanges (expects 1-based start position)

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via REST API — catalog_queries
text: gene_variants() returns tibble describing variants associated gene; use verbose = TRUE retrieve extensive information. variant_genes() returns tibble describing genes associated variant; use verbose = TRUE retrieve extensive information. gene_elements() returns tibble describing elements associated gene; use verbose = TRUE retrieve extensive information. elements() returns GRanges object describing elements. element_genes() returns tibble describing genomic element gene pairs.

what: Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB — db_queries
title: Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB — db_queries
text: edges() nodes() identify edges nodes data base. db_gene_variants() locates variants associated (Ensembl) gene identifier. db_gene_elements() locates genomic elements associated (Ensembl) gene identifier.

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB — db_queries
code: db_edges(   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )  db_nodes(   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )  db_gene_variants(   gene_id,   threshold,   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )  db_gene_elements(   gene_id,   threshold,   username = rigvf_config$get("username"),   password = rigvf_config$get("password") )

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB — db_queries
text: username character(1) ArangoDB user name. Default: "guest". password character(1) ArangoDB password. Default: "guestigvfcatalog". better practice use environment variable record password, rather encoding script, password = Sys.getenv("RIGVF_ARANGODB_PASSWORD"). gene_id character(1) Ensembl gene identifier threshold numeric(1) minimum association statistic, minus log10 p-value variants, score elements

title: Query the IGVF Catalog via ArangoDB — db_queries
text: edges() nodes() return tibble edge node name count occurrences database. db_gene_variants() returns tibble summarizing variants associated gene. db_gene_elements() returns tibble summarizing genomic elements associated gene.
